dif.summary: Ensure the intended payment reaches one correct terminal outcome without an unintended duplicate financial action.

allowed_paths: recover or read the existing transaction state
replay only when the contract provides safe idempotent semantics
wait for stronger evidence when terminality is not established
blocked_paths: blindly issue a new non-idempotent payment while prior commit state is unknown
constraints: another financial commit may be irreversible
the original commit state is unknown
retry semantics must be known before another create request is safe

drp.decision_summary: Do not issue a new financial commit while the original operation remains ambiguous; recover prior operation state first.

tip.action_summary: Perform the contract-defined recovery or read operation before any new financial commit.
